Their commutator C0=P0Q0-Q0P0 has rows (0,pq,-pq),(-p(1-q),0,p(1-q)),((1-p)q,-(1-p)q,0). The integral kernel K_ij=C0_ij/m_j is skew in the product-measure block masses, and every output block depends only on input block means. Thus the L∞ norm equals maximum absolute row sum 2max{pq,p(1-q),(1-p)q}, attained by block signs; L1 equality is dual since C*=-C in weighted L². Pairwise comparisons give the stated three regions and ties. On orthonormal normalized block indicators H_ij=K_ij sqrt(m_i m_j) is real skew with squared nonzero singular value pq(1-pq), so eigenvalues ±i sqrt(pq(1-pq)); C kills the orthogonal complement. As p=q→1 endpoint norm→2 while Hilbert norm→0. Independently verified symbolic matrix, skewness, C³=-pq(1-pq)C, and row sums. Arbitrary underlying probability spaces are covered because the 3-block kernel is exact.
